title: Experimental manifest (experimental.yaml)
description: The index of a pack's experimental material: measured operating points and jump thresholds layered over the shipped descriptors, and the sensors that ship no shipped point, read only under `nxs --experimental`. Never shipped; the shipped pack manifest never names it.

experimental.description: The pack this material belongs to.

overlays.description: Chip directory -> overlay directory beside this file.

chips.description: Sensors the product does not ship (no shipped point), joining the pack after its shipped sensors: each a chip directory beside this file.
